# Missed No More Pro

> AI receptionist and smart CRM for local service businesses (1–15 employees) — towing, roadside assistance, locksmiths, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, garage doors, pest control, landscaping, cleaning, mobile mechanics, appliance repair, and handyman trades.

Missed No More Pro answers a service business's phone 24/7, qualifies the caller, computes an exact price from the owner's own rates and real driving distance (never an invented price), books the job on the calendar inside owner-approved hours, and follows up by text. It warm-transfers complicated or upset callers to a real person on the team instead of guessing. Every call becomes a tracked lead in a built-in CRM with a transcript, summary, and dollar value attributed to the revenue it saved.

Pricing is usage-capped (AI minutes) with hard caps and no surprise overage — plans run from $79/mo (Starter, 250 AI minutes, 1 user) to $479/mo (Elite, 1,500 AI minutes, 25 users), plus a custom Enterprise tier. Every plan includes a 7-day free trial (card required).
